rationale: The declaration faithfully models the Erdős–Rényi G(n,p) distribution, ordinary vertex degree, common expected degree (n - 1)p, one simultaneous strict all-vertices deviation event, and its probability ≥ 0.9. Every supplied dependency and all twelve configured core checks were reviewed. The only consequential logical asymmetry is that Lean instantiates the source's existential absolute constant with the uniform, nonvacuous value 4000. Therefore Lean implies the source but the source statement does not imply the concrete Lean bound, yielding faithful-stronger. The explicit n ≥ 2 condition resolves the source's unstated small-n convention; no implication, dependency, or semantic check remains unclear, so adjudication is not requested.
